description: This file defines the Range class, which represents a numerical range with minimum and maximum float values, including constructors and accessor methods.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Represents a numerical range with minimum and maximum values, providing methods to access these values and compute the range width.

methods.name: Range(double min, double max)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Range with double precision inputs, converting them to floats.

methods.name: Range(float min, float max)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Range with float values.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the range.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the range.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the range (max - min).
